data.additional_notes:
This is on the "Performance" power preset, roughly 25w TDP. Technically the game could be pushed further if you were docked and wanted to push into the 30-33w TDP territory, at the cost of heat and fan noise. 

Start with the High Graphics Preset, and switch to Intel XeSS upscaler, Quality.

For Mods, download the NexusMods App from GitHub and be sure to use WineTricks/Protontricks to install vcrun2022 and d3dcompiler_47. Then add this to the launch option in Steam.

WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winmm,version=n,b" %command%

Alternatively for Heroic Games Launcher, set the Environmental variable WINEDLLOVERRIDES with the value "winmm,version=n,b" (including quotes).

data.additional_notes:
Use Decky-Framegen to install Optiscaler, which will auto-install the updated FSR4 DLL into the Cyberpunk 2077 directory, or manually find and install the FSR 4.0.2 DLL. FSR4 looks much better than FSR2, FSR3, and Intel XeSS 2.0 and is worth the additional configuration.

Set Quick Preset to "SteamDeck", and the only thing you need to change is the Resolution Scaling from FSR2 to FSR4.

While not strictly necessary, you can change the VSYNC setting on the Display Settings page to 48, which may have a bit less latency than using the Steam Quick Access Menu's overlay.

For Mods, download the NexusMods App from GitHub and be sure to use WineTricks/Protontricks to install `vcrun2022` and `d3dcompiler_47`. Then add this to the launch option in Steam.

`WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winmm,version=n,b" %command%`

Alternatively for Heroic Games Launcher, set the Environmental variable `WINEDLLOVERRIDES` with the value `"winmm,version=n,b"` (including quotes).

[Cyberpunk 2077 modding on Linux](https://wiki.redmodding.org/cyberpunk-2077-modding/for-mod-users/users-modding-cyberpunk-2077/modding-on-linux)
[NexusMods App](https://github.com/Nexus-Mods/NexusMods.App/releases/)
